market.rules_primary: If the value of the Index.US30/USD is at least $50,750 at 10am EDT on Oct 05, 2026, then the market resolves to Yes.
market.rules_secondary:
The market resolves based on the value of the Index.US30/USD at the exact time specified in 10am EDT on Oct 05, 2026, as reported by Pyth Network, using the index's natively published level in its own currency and units; no currency conversion is applied. If the value of the Index.US30/USD at 10am EDT on Oct 05, 2026 is at least $50,750, the market resolves to Yes. If not, the market resolves to No. Revisions to the underlying made after expiration will not be accounted for in determining the Expiration Value.

If no data is available for 10am EDT on Oct 05, 2026 by the Expiration Date, all strikes other than "No data" or "None" resolve to No. The index level is evaluated to two decimal places unless otherwise specified.
market.title: Will the Index.US30/USD be at least $50,750 at October 5, 2026 at 10am ET?
